reason.description: Why Cloud refused rather than answering with a partial or unchecked document: `provider_unavailable` (Lexware did not answer or answered with an error), `rate_limited` (Lexware throttled the request; nothing was read), `list_limit_exceeded` (Lexware reports more than 10,000 documents for the org), `list_changed` (the document list changed while it was being paged, so no consistent list exists), `unsupported_document` (the detail or the file only: Lexware answered with an e-invoice profile or a file this cloud cannot present as the document), `profile_mismatch` (the Lexware account this cloud is configured with failed its account check, so every Lexware read stays closed).
